ingredientSections.heading: Earl Grey Pisco Sour
items: 30ml Fresh Lemon Juice (juice of 1 large lemon)

methodSections.heading: Earl Grey Pisco Sour
steps: In a cocktail shaker combine fresh lemon juice, Pisco, vanilla syrup, egg whites.
Fill shaker with ice and shake again vigorously for a minute or until foamy.
Strain into a snifter glass or champagne flute and add three drops of Angostura Bitters as garnish.

methodSections.heading: Vanilla Simple Syrup
steps: Combine equal parts water and sugar and bring to gentle boil. Reduce heat and gently simmer for 30 min.
Remove from heat, add the vanilla bean pod and allow to cool.

methodSections.heading: Earl Grey Infused Pisco
steps: In large mixing bowl infuse the tea in the Pisco for two hours.
Remove tea bags and transfer infused Pisco back into original bottle.
